purpose: Retrospectively continue the strong-aligned-spin fixed-input field-derivative pilot from 0.1 M to 0.05 and 0.025 M centered five-point stencils, using the already captured dense-field evidence. This is not an independent prospective holdout or a waveform run.
fixed: captured trajectory and mode values at the historical match
derivative_metric: Linf over all seven first- and second-derivative rows, excluding the fixed captured values
coefficient_metric: Euclidean distance of the five active NQC coefficients
order_ratio_definition: For adjacent halved-step differences D(h,h/2), report D(h,h/2)/D(h/2,h/4) and its base-2 logarithm separately for derivatives and coefficients. This is a diagnostic observed order, not a Richardson error bound.
interpretation: Keep the prior 0.1/0.2 M coefficient-L2 failure visible. Report finer adjacent differences and tolerance sensitivity regardless of whether they improve. Monotonicity flags are descriptive, not promotion gates. No stencil is selected after looking at this continuation; full-waveform and independent physical validation remain outstanding.
